notes.title: v1.14 version update
notes.notes:
1. All orange equipment has been changed to random attributes, and duplicate equipment drops are now supported.

2. Orange equipment drops have been added to Chapter 3 bosses.

3. Added equipment synthesis functionality to Wizard NPCs.

notes.title: v1.12 version update
notes.notes:
1. Added Shield Cards for Defense, Invincibility, Shield Bash, Shield Charge, Block and Counter.

2. Added a large number of special moves and 5-card skill sets.

3. Added a new starting relic selection function.

4. Added a new three-weapon combo function.

5. Adjusted the maximum skill level from 6 to 3, making leveling more noticeable.

notes.title: v1.11 version update
notes.notes:
1. New card control mode and new player guide

2. Increased drop rates from bosses and treasure chests

3. Redesigned skill UI

4. Reduced potion price and optimized tooltips

5. Frame rate support with three settings options

6. Added UI effects for slam attacks

7. Shows the maximum possible stats for Witch Contracts

8. Implemented continuous randomization of Witch Contracts

9. Optimized NPC interaction UI

notes.title: v1.10 version update
notes.notes:
1.A second backpack has been added.

2.Potions have been redesigned and can now be brought into combat.

3.A wizard's hut has been added to towns, activating the ability to equip the Witch Pact set.

4.Added more buffs to cooking, including elemental and hit points.

5.Monster damage has been increased to balance the benefits of the above features.

notes.title: v1.9 version update
notes.notes:
1. Added an Encounter System

2. Added multiple weapons for each weapon level

3. Redesigned cooking rules to accommodate any combination of ingredients

3. Combining dual forward and dual backward skills allows you to pass through monsters and avoid being surrounded

notes.title: v1.8 version update
notes.notes:
1. Added a new strength system. When your hand is not good, you can choose to take fewer actions to accumulate strength, which can be used to trigger a stronger skill and attack next time.

2. Added a steam achievement system

notes.title: v1.7 version update
notes.notes:
1. Implemented cloud archive function

2. Optimized the novice guide, removed the guide that is easy to get stuck, and changed it to a guide for fixed mandatory action card use

3. Fixed the bug that the backpack icon gets stuck when dragging props

4. Some icons opened in the level have animation effects, which are more obvious to indicate clickability

5. Reduced the refresh cost of relics

6. The use of medicine bottles no longer consumes durability

7. Optimized the interaction with NPCs in the main city

notes.title: The official release of Dark Ranger has been postponed to mid-July
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45422640/19aaaf95b76c5b08e4d856e2dd1574bd291afdef.png"]

We are a small team with limited publicity resources, and we are very grateful for your continued support!

The original release date coincided with the Steam Summer Sale. We are worried that the exposure of new products will be seriously affected during large-scale promotions, so we decided to postpone the official launch of "Night Ranger" to mid-July

During this period, we will continue to polish the game and add more gameplay content, such as upgrading belts, building storage boxes and other systems, hoping to bring you a more complete gaming experience!

Thank you for your understanding and waiting! Stay tuned!
